Each panel shows a waist-up anime girl in front of a wooden bookshelf. Use soft indoor lighting, gentle shadows, detailed book spines, and a calm library/cafe atmosphere. Each character’s face is intentionally covered by a centered soft dark square blur/censor block, while hair, clothing, hands, and books remain visible.

Layout: Four panels arranged in a strict grid: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. In every panel, place a rounded white caption card with a subtle colored outline near the bottom, containing the recommender name, the book title in Japanese quotation marks, and a short recommendation sentence. Do not fill every shelf completely; leave believable gaps, varied book heights, and some partially empty spaces for realism.

Panel details, exactly 4 recommendation scenes:
1. Top-left: A gentle girl with black hair in low side buns and loose curls, wearing a pale lavender cardigan over a white floral dress, holding a landscape book showing Mount Fuji, a lake, and flowers. Bookshelf behind her includes travel, world architecture, and art books. Caption card with purple outline: 「紫苑リンのおすすめ」, 「『美しい日本の風景』」, 「美しい景色を見ると、心が癒されます。」
2. Top-right: A fashionable girl with very long straight black hair, pink ribbon bows, and a soft pink cardigan, holding a beige fashion book with a girl illustration on the cover. Bookshelf behind her includes beauty, makeup, fashion, and comic volumes. Caption card with pink outline: 「紫苑レイのおすすめ」, 「『大人かわいいの作り方』」, 「おしゃれは、自分をもっと好きになる魔法。」
3. Bottom-left: A sporty/energetic short-haired black-haired girl in a white hoodie, holding up a dark science-fiction adventure book with a starry galaxy cover and pointing at it. items.title: Funny DIY Disaster Cat Comic
items.prompt: Create a vibrant, humorous Spanish-language cartoon poster in a vertical format. It should feature a retro cartoon look, bold black outlines, warm orange and yellow tones, halftone textures, and exaggerated, lively characters. The layout is divided into four independent panels: a large title panel at the top, and three equally sized vertical panels at the bottom. In the top panel, a smug orange tabby cat repairman stands upright like a human in his comfortable living room studio, one paw holding a screwdriver, the other at his hip, wearing a tool belt with clearly visible tools. The cat squints confidently, a sly smile on its face. To the left of this panel is a large, jagged cartoon-style exploding frame containing the Spanish title in bold, distressed font: “3 PASOS PARA ARRUINAR ALGO FÁCIL,” with “ARRUINAR” in red and the rest in black. Below this is a strip of washi tape that reads “edición casera.” In the top panel background, a sign that reads "YO PUEDO SOLO" hangs on the wall, next to a small paw print, a small plant, a shelf, and dynamic radiating lines behind the cat. In the bottom row, create three labeled step panels, each with a yellow title box and bold black text. Panel 1, titled "PASO 1," shows the same orange cat sitting calmly by a floor lamp, eyes closed, looking overly confident, casually holding a screwdriver. Add a speech bubble that reads "Tranqui, esto lo arreglo en 2 minutos." Includes an open toolbox and several screws on the floor. Panel 2, titled "PASO 2," shows the cat currently repairing, now panicked, eyes wide, clumsily disassembling the wrong part of the lamp, debris and screws flying through the air. Add a speech bubble that reads "Ups..." and a note near the bottom that reads "tocar lo que no era." Includes visual movement lines, scattered debris, and overturned flowerpots. Panel 3, titled "PASO 3". Showing the consequences: broken and smoking light fixtures, exposed and sparking wires, a messy room with broken parts everywhere, and a cat sitting in shock, holding a screwdriver. A brown dog stands to the right, looking disappointed, asking in a speech bubble, "¿Qué hiciste?" The cat replies in another speech bubble, "No sé... se complicó solo." Add a washi tape label at the bottom that reads "resultado final". This makes the whole image fun, chaotic, and emoji-like, using beautiful digital illustrations, lively expressions, cartoon fonts, and a DIY disaster tone.
